sentences.text: In a small town, there lived a girl named Mia.
She wanted to be a great artist.
Every day, she drew pictures in her notebook.
Her room was full of unfinished art.
One day, Mia's friend, Sam, visited her.
Sam saw the mess in Mia's room.
"Why don’t you finish your art?" he asked.
Sam took out a big piece of paper.
"This is your goal tree," he said.
Each leaf is a step to reach that goal."
They wrote her main goal at the top: "Finish my art!"
Another branch said, "Join an art class."
The last branch said, "Show my art to friends."
For example, under "Draw every day," they wrote, "Spend 30 minutes drawing after school."
Under "Join an art class," they wrote, "Find a class in town."
The next day, she started to draw.
She set a timer for 30 minutes.
Mia felt proud when she finished it.
The next week, she found an art class.
They shared ideas and helped each other.
Soon, she had many finished drawings.
One day, she decided to show her art to her friends.
They encouraged her to show her art in a local gallery.
She took a deep breath and said yes.
The day of the gallery came.
Many people came to see it.
She learned that setting goals helped her grow.
Now, she was not just a dreamer.
